answer: The thread cap is enforced at intake and lantern shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch however much capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a cedar tag. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
